papers.title: Fitted Q-Learning for Relational Domains
papers.abstract: We consider the problem of Approximate Dynamic Programming in relational domains. We introduce a first-order representation of the value function and present a fitted Q-learning algorithm that learns relational regression trees.

papers.abstract: An attention-guided ResNet autoencoder combining residual learning with CBAM to focus on engraved strokes while ignoring palm-leaf background texture, trained on 1,350 Kannada manuscripts.
